final_text:
All tests passed successfully.

To summarize the changes:
- Inventory class now supports stock reservations with reserve, release methods.
- Available stock counts on-hand minus reserved.
- OrderService creates orders by reserving stock first, raising InsufficientStock if any line can't be reserved.
- Cancelling pending orders releases reservations.
- Fulfilling orders converts reservations into actual deductions.
- Reports still use on-hand stock without considering reservations.
- Added tests to confirm new reservation logic, cancellations, and availability behavior.

The solution fulfills all requirements, fully tested, and no test failures.
